observation.week1_coverage: 176/176 named Finals Week 1 roster identities reconciled; no identity is removed because of absent news.
basis: The canonical Finals Week 1 player statistical population and its batches were captured before the relevant Finals Week 1 matches were completed.
The coverage record itself retains incomplete per-round reconciliation and a LEGACY_COUNTER_NOT_RECONCILED_THIS_CYCLE state.

Therefore the stored aggregates remain valid contemporaneous historical captures but must not be represented as guaranteed post-Finals-Week-1 current statistics for players whose Week 1 match changed their season totals or recent-form sample. Players who did not play Week 1 remain persistent but also require freshness revalidation before a role-critical statistical comparison is treated as current.
not_claimed: No claim is made that every official NRL profile has already published a Finals Week 1 row.
No statistic is backfilled, projected or guessed.
No player identity is removed or marked unavailable solely because the statistical refresh is pending.

decision_effect: NO_TIP_OR_CONFIDENCE_CHANGE. If a confidence freeze were attempted before this freshness defect is reconciled, the mandatory player-statistical comparison gate must be REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than presented as fully current.
